description: This file contains utility functions and constants for managing CSS class names and sizes in a split-pane component, including BEM naming conventions and size assertions.

methods.name: getBEMElement
methods.description: Constructs a BEM element class name from block and element names.

methods.name: getBEMModifier
methods.description: Constructs a BEM modifier class name from block or element and modifier.

methods.name: classNames
methods.description: Concatenates multiple class name arguments into a single string, handling objects and other types.

methods.name: assertsSize
methods.description: Converts size specifications (string or number) into a numeric value, supporting 'auto', pixel, and percentage units.
